name: Open PhotoSync on arriving home
description: PhotoSync 4.3.4 cancels its scheduled autotransfer check and disables its boot receiver the moment it comes to the foreground, and re-arms both only when it goes to the background. Swiping it from Recents in that window, or One UI reclaiming it then, leaves autotransfer disarmed until the app is next opened and backgrounded, and a reboot does not restore it. Opening the app on arrival re-arms the schedule and runs an immediate scan, so this rule is the recovery for that state. It is a stopgap, not the design: if PhotoSync is left backgrounded rather than swiped away, its own 15-minute check works and this rule can stay disarmed. The lease check keeps it to the home LAN, and the wait lets the default route move off mobile data first. Needs the appear-on-top grant; kata reports it as unmet otherwise.
